environment: Debian 13, Godot 4.6.1 .NET, GL Compatibility, Mesa llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7; Xorg dummy over loopback TCP; 1280x800 mobile layout; frozen production fixture at unchanged 1.5x zoom; no VSync support
method: Sequential baseline then final processes, no parallel local test/build work; six 120-frame intervals each; summary is median of interval statistics for iterations 1..5. This is one noisy hosted software-renderer pair, not a hardware benchmark.
limits: Initial import/JIT/first GPU completion not isolated; readyMs includes 12 process frames and scheduling, not CPU build time.
No physical Samsung Galaxy S25 measurement.
Lookup bytes are RG8 payload; engine-wide texture/buffer counters include all game resources.
No GPU timer-query attribution or process working-set measurement.
Six same-fixture rebuilds are a bounded resource observation; existing environment suite additionally alternates production regions.
